Option B :

The gravitational force acting on the astronaut while in orbit is less than the gravitational force at the Earth's surface, but it is not zero. The force of gravity decreases with the square of the distance from the center of the Earth. Since the astronaut is at a distance ( R + h ) from the center of the Earth, where ( h ) is the altitude of the orbit, the gravitational force will be less than at the Earth's surface but greater than zero.
